original_test_intent: Verify the complete Contained Object Handles collection for the intended SMBIOS Type 2 baseboard matches the approved contained-object topology, every handle resolves to the expected structure type/identity, and the relationship persists after reboot.
original_method: Capture the full SMBIOS table and target Type 2 record, obtain the declared handle count and complete handle list, resolve each reference to exactly one structure, compare cardinality, membership and target identities with the approved topology, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the target board, expected contained-object graph and reboot plan. Complete-list parsing, reference resolution and graph comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Approved contained-object count/graph or explicit expected empty list
Expected referenced record types and identities
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only and retain the complete table, parser output and errors.
Do not use a fixed one-line grep context as proof of a variable-length list.
Validate declared count, multiplicity and every reference; reject dangling, duplicate, wrong-type or unintended targets.
Do not treat zero handles as failure when an approved platform topology explicitly expects none.
Stop on ambiguity, graph drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Select the intended Type 2 record, parse its count and entire handle array, resolve every edge to record type/identity and compare the graph before/after reboot.
Do not modify SMBIOS, invent topology or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the expected graph, empty-list policy, target types and board mapping.
Resolve topology discrepancies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Insufficient because `grep -A1` can capture only the heading/count or first entry, suppresses errors and cannot resolve a variable-length set to referenced records.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive the complete SMBIOS table or all required decoded structures with tool version/errors, parse the target Type 2 declared count and full handle array, then resolve all references by handle.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Contained Object Handles scope, linked Type 2 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Parse cardinality and all contained-object edges from the selected Type 2 structure, resolve each against the same table, compare type/identity/multiplicity with the approved graph and preserve both raw and semantic graphs across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 2 systems that populate contained-object handles, including valid zero-count cases.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, parser/dmidecode, BIOS and BOM revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 2 Contained Object Handles semantics and installed tooling documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Eliminates truncated list evidence and validates the referenced object graph rather than isolated hexadecimal tokens.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; adds count, completeness and referential-integrity checks.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected graph and record identity rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Handle numbers may be table-instance identifiers; semantic target identity should be retained alongside raw values.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve an empty or platform-specific graph, but must state expected count, target types/identities and whether raw handle numbering or only semantic graph stability is required.
expected_evidence: Approval, expected graph/count/types, board mapping and tool/SMBIOS versions
Complete pre-reboot target Type 2 plus all referenced structures and resolution graph

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently identifies the Type 2 contained-object collection and reboot persistence; it is underspecified only by project topology data.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The list and handle semantics are clear and safely readable; the expected graph is a readiness input.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Replaces a potentially truncated grep excerpt with complete collection and resolution.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps graph semantics and recovery while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds cardinality, multiplicity, valid-empty and raw-versus-semantic stability rules.

review_improvement: Prevents partial lists, dangling references, wrong target types and an approved zero-object topology from being misjudged.
independent_technical_reasoning: The entire core acceptance path is table parsing and graph comparison after inputs are approved; no physical setup or manual observation is inherent in the case.
